name: Timers
description: Timers, stopwatches and alarms in notes: ```timer duration=25m label="Focus"```, ```stopwatch``` and ```alarm at=07:30```. They keep going when their note closes or the page reloads, show in the status bar while they run, and ring and notify when they're done.

editor.why: Draw timers, stopwatches and alarms in notes

notifications.why: Say when a timer is done or an alarm goes off

media.why: Ring when a timer is done or an alarm goes off

embeds.title: Timer
embeds.description: Counts down from a duration, then rings and notifies. Start, pause and reset it in the note; it keeps going when the note closes.

label.description: What it's for, shown with it and in the status bar

id.description: Keeps its state when blocks move or change; leave it as it is

embeds.title: Stopwatch
embeds.description: Counts up from zero. Start, pause and reset it in the note; it keeps going when the note closes.

id.description: Keeps its state when blocks move or change; leave it as it is

embeds.title: Alarm
embeds.description: Rings and notifies at a time of day, every day it's on, while Common Ink is open.

id.description: Keeps its state when blocks move or change; leave it as it is
